Berkeley CS 185/285      Deep Reinforcement Learning, Decision Making, and Control                    Spring 2026


                                      Assignment 5: Offline RL
                                           Due April 19, 11:59 pm


1     Introduction
In this assignment, you will implement three offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms and evaluate them
on continuous control tasks. In part 1 and part 2, you will implement two offline RL algorithms that train
Gaussian policies: SAC+BC (Haarnoja et al., 2018a; Fujimoto and Gu, 2021) and IQL (Kostrikov et al.,
2022). In part 3, you will implement an offline RL algorithm that trains expressive flow policies: FQL (Park
et al., 2025b). You will tune and evaluate these algorithms on simulated robotic tasks from the OGBench
